title: Benchmark SQLite LogStorage insert throughput
description:
Add a criterion benchmark that inserts 10,000 log entries into a SqliteLogStorage in a temp file. Measures inserts/second and total time. Also benchmarks get_entry for random IDs. Artifact: crates/core/benches/sqlite_storage.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- benchmark uses a temp file (not in-memory SQLite)
- reports inserts/sec and get p50/p99
- result provides a realistic lower bound on transit ingestion rate
